registry_description: What pharmacies actually pay for prescriptions (CMS NADAC) plus fair-cash-price estimates.

tools.description: Look up what US pharmacies actually pay to acquire a drug (CMS NADAC benchmark), a fair cash-price estimate range, FDA generic equivalents, and Medicare negotiated prices where applicable. Returns match, candidates (disambiguate and call again), or no_match.

query.description: Drug name with optional strength/form, e.g. "atorvastatin 20 mg" or "eliquis 5 mg tablet". Generic (ingredient) names match best.
